person: Lorna Pike is 58 and the office and compliance manager at Harlan Ridge Supply, a small importer with its own trucks. The company brings in truck diagnostic scanners and cold-chain data loggers, and a small side of its business re-exports them. She has 22 years of customs entries, permits and filings behind her, but export screening is the newer and thinner part of her job. She was burned two years ago by a freight-audit AI vendor that overpromised, so she wants every call tied to a named rule and a source line, and she wants a practice run called a practice run. She clears the week's export orders before the 3 pm carrier pickup, and the owner signs off on anything large or unusual.
stated_up_front: I have eight export orders to clear before the 3 o'clock pickup. Go through them and tell me, order by order, which rule you applied and where it comes from. Anything you're unsure of, say so, don't guess.

facts.about: Size of the week's export queue
facts.truth: Eight orders, total invoice value $61,400, all due on the Thursday 3 pm carrier pickup.
Harlan Ridge Supply re-exports truck diagnostic scanners and cold-chain data loggers; her classification sheet lists them as EAR99.

Maple Crest Instruments Ltd., Mississauga, Ontario, a $5,200 order. The name resembles a Shenzhen Entity List entry, but the address, country and registration number are all different and the customer has bought from her for six years.
Al Noor Marine Trading FZE, Jebel Ali Free Zone, a $3,900 order. The name resembles a Tehran SDN entry, but the trade licence number and address differ.

facts.about: Unverified List customer with a complete statement
facts.truth: Anadolu Soguk Zincir A.S., Istanbul, $11,800. Their signed UVL statement came in by email on Tuesday and names the end use, the end user and the location.

facts.about: Unverified List customer with a weak statement
facts.truth: Viet Frost Logistics JSC, Hai Phong, $7,600. Their statement is unsigned and does not say where the goods will be used.

facts.about: Entity List buyer under another name
facts.truth: Kestrel Sensor Systems, $9,100. Screening scored it only 86, but the ship-to address is the same as an Entity List entry that lists Kestrel as one of its other names.
Tarvos Aviation Parts, $4,300, which appears on the Denied Persons List.
Nordvik Logistics, Almaty, $8,700. No list names it, but an ownership notice in her inbox shows a sanctioned holding company owns 60% of it.
Eastgate Freight Services, Hong Kong, $10,800. It paid over the invoice, will not name its buyer and asked for the sensors to be marked spare parts.
Nothing ships after 3 pm; the owner signs anything over $5,000 that is unusual, so she would tell him about any hold on the larger orders.

unknowns: What the 86 match score means and how much weight to give it
Exactly what a UVL statement must contain under the rule
Whether the stayed affiliates rule affects the one customer that is an affiliate of a listed entity, or what happens when the stay ends on 9 November
Whether the sanctioned holding company's 60% ownership alone bars shipping to Nordvik
